start.if: flag('leaving_with_dex') and present('dex') and npc_in('dex', 'hangar') and time_between(1, 5)

look.speaker: narrator
look.text: The <c>Magpie</c>: a short-hop shuttle older than the reactor. Six seats, one of them with the padding still in it. The hull is cold, but somebody has been keeping the engine seals greased.

hatch.speaker: narrator

variants.text: Through the scratched port of the hatch you can make out crates that have no business being in a mothballed shuttle. Ration boxes. The blue shimmer of a fuel cell.
The hatch is locked. Through its scratched port the hold looks empty. For now.

do: if container_count('shuttle_hold', 'ration_pack') > 0 and not flag('knows_dex_scheme'): set_flag('saw_magpie_cargo')

gone.speaker: narrator
gone.text: Scorch marks on the pad, and a draught where the Magpie used to be.

board.speaker: dex
board.text: Last call, friend. Seat's still warm for you. Once we're past the ring shadow nobody can call us back.

choices.text: Let's go. This station was dead before I got here.
